summary: Make crash-loop retry backoff coverage deterministic by advancing the existing test clock to one millisecond before and exactly at each deadline, asserting attempts and recorded retry decisions on those boundaries instead of comparing independently sampled wall times.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no historical claims or runtime state are replayed.

schema.detail: No claim fields, stored formats, database migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: Production crash-loop retry policy, backoff arithmetic, retention and checkpoint rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only integration-test clock handling and assertions change; no CLI, API, wire or mixed-version behavior changes.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment change or downtime is required for this test-only correction.

manual.detail: No operator action, state repair or migration is needed.

recovery.detail: There is no production-state change to recover. Reverting restores the wall-clock-dependent test without changing runtime retry behavior.
